Section 1b: Temporal trends
- Is VPD becoming more important in recent years in long-term sites?
- Extreme summer events
- Predictability over time

```{r}
library(zoo)

long_term_sites <- c("How", "Tum", "Wom", "Asm", "Cpr")

vpd_trend <- sites_daily_df %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  drop_na(GPP, VPD) %>%                   # remove NAs before grouping
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  filter(n() >= 10) %>%                   # stricter threshold — 3 is too few for a regression
  summarise(
    R2_annual = summary(lm(GPP ~ VPD))$r.squared,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Plot R² over time per site
ggplot(vpd_trend, aes(x = year, y = R2_annual, colour = site)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#4682B4","#F28C28","#2ca02c","#d62728","#9467bd")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Annual R² (GPP ~ VPD)", 
       title = "Is VPD becoming more important over time?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Test significance of trend per site
vpd_trend %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    slope  = coef(lm(R2_annual ~ year))[2],
    p_value = summary(lm(R2_annual ~ year))$coefficients[2, 4]
  )
```
```{r}
vpd_trend_summary <- tibble(
  site    = c("Asm", "Cpr", "How", "Tum", "Wom"),
  slope   = c(0.00975, 0.00571, -0.01857, 0.00419, 0.00290),
  p_value = c(0.061, 0.289, 0.014, 0.629, 0.610)
) %>%
  mutate(
    significant = p_value < 0.05,
    label       = paste0("p = ", round(p_value, 3))
  )

ggplot(vpd_trend_summary, aes(x = reorder(site, slope), y = slope, 
                               fill = significant)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label,
                hjust = ifelse(slope > 0, -0.1, 1.1)),
            size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#4682B4", "FALSE" = "grey70"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "p < 0.05", "FALSE" = "p ≥ 0.05")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.025, 0.015)) +  # expand range for labels
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Trend in annual R² (GPP ~ VPD)",
       fill = NULL,
       title = "Is VPD becoming more important over time?",
       subtitle = "Slope of R² ~ year per long-term site") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.margin = margin(5, 60, 5, 5, unit = "pt"))
```

```{r}
# ── Calculate VPD anomalies and flag extremes ─────────────────────────────────
vpd_extremes <- sites_daily_df %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  drop_na(VPD) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    vpd_mean     = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    vpd_sd       = sd(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    vpd_anomaly  = VPD - vpd_mean,                    # raw anomaly
    vpd_z        = vpd_anomaly / vpd_sd,              # standardised anomaly
    extreme      = vpd_z > 1.5                        # flag extremes (adjust threshold as needed)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
vpd_extreme_annual <- vpd_extremes %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_extreme    = sum(extreme, na.rm = TRUE),         # count of extreme days
    prop_extreme = mean(extreme, na.rm = TRUE),        # proportion of days
    mean_anomaly = mean(vpd_anomaly, na.rm = TRUE),    # mean annual anomaly
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(vpd_extreme_annual, aes(x = year, y = n_extreme, colour = site)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.15) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = "No. extreme VPD days per year",
       title = "Are VPD extremes becoming more frequent?",
       subtitle = "Extreme = VPD > 1.5 SD above site mean") +
```

```{r}
# ── Step 1: Calculate VPD extremes using 95th percentile ─────────────────────
vpd_extremes_daily <- bind_rows(sites_daily) %>%
  drop_na(VPD, date) %>%
  mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    vpd_mean    = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    vpd_anomaly = VPD - vpd_mean,
    vpd_p95     = quantile(VPD, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    extreme     = VPD > vpd_p95
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ── Q1: Are VPD anomalies increasing in frequency? ───────────────────────────
vpd_annual_extremes <- vpd_extremes_daily %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(n_extreme = sum(extreme, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(vpd_annual_extremes %>% filter(site %in% long_term_sites),
       aes(x = year, y = n_extreme)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, colour = "#F28C28") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "#4682B4", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "No. days above 95th percentile",
       title = "Are extreme VPD events becoming more frequent?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# significance
vpd_annual_extremes %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    slope   = coef(lm(n_extreme ~ year))[2],
    p_value = summary(lm(n_extreme ~ year))$coefficients[2, 4]
  )

# ── Q2: Are VPD anomalies increasing in magnitude? ───────────────────────────
vpd_annual_anom <- vpd_extremes_daily %>%
  filter(extreme) %>%                           # only look at extreme days
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(mean_extreme_vpd = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(vpd_annual_anom %>% filter(site %in% long_term_sites),
       aes(x = year, y = mean_extreme_vpd)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, colour = "#F28C28") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "#4682B4", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean VPD on extreme days (kPa)",
       title = "Are VPD extremes becoming more intense?") +
  theme_classic()

# ── Q3: Do extremes coincide with low precipitation? ─────────────────────────
vpd_extremes_daily %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  drop_na(Precip) %>%
  mutate(extreme_flag = ifelse(extreme, "Extreme VPD", "Normal")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = extreme_flag, y = Precip, fill = extreme_flag)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Extreme VPD" = "#F28C28", "Normal" = "#4682B4")) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Daily Precipitation (mm)",
       title = "Do extreme VPD days coincide with low precipitation?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── Q4: Do extremes coincide with low GPP? ───────────────────────────────────
vpd_extremes_daily %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  drop_na(GPP) %>%
  mutate(extreme_flag = ifelse(extreme, "Extreme VPD", "Normal")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = extreme_flag, y = GPP, fill = extreme_flag)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Extreme VPD" = "#F28C28", "Normal" = "#4682B4")) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GPP",
       title = "Do extreme VPD days coincide with low GPP?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ── Summary statistics for Q3 and Q4 ─────────────────────────────────────────
vpd_extremes_daily %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  drop_na(GPP, Precip) %>%
  group_by(site, extreme) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_GPP    = mean(GPP,    na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_Precip = mean(Precip, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(extreme = ifelse(extreme, "Extreme", "Normal")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = extreme,
              values_from = c(mean_GPP, mean_Precip))
```
```{r}
# ── Step 1: Filter to austral summer and calculate extremes ───────────────────
vpd_summer <- bind_rows(sites_daily) %>%
  drop_na(VPD, GPP, date) %>%
  mutate(
    year  = year(date),
    month = month(date)
  ) %>%
  filter(month %in% c(12, 1, 2)) %>%           # austral summer only
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    vpd_p95     = quantile(VPD, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),  # summer-specific 95th
    extreme     = VPD > vpd_p95
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ── Step 2: GPP ~ VPD sensitivity per site per year (summer only) ─────────────
vpd_sensitivity_summer <- vpd_summer %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  filter(n() >= 10) %>%
  summarise(
    vpd_slope = coef(lm(GPP ~ VPD))[2],
    R2        = summary(lm(GPP ~ VPD))$r.squared,
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

# ── Step 3: Plot sensitivity trend over time — long-term sites ────────────────
vpd_sensitivity_summer %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = vpd_slope)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, colour = "#4682B4") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "#F28C28", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GPP ~ VPD slope (summer)",
       title = "Is summer GPP sensitivity to VPD changing over time?") +
  theme_classic()

# ── Step 4: Significance of sensitivity trend ─────────────────────────────────
vpd_sensitivity_summer %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    slope   = coef(lm(vpd_slope ~ year))[2],
    p_value = summary(lm(vpd_slope ~ year))$coefficients[2, 4]
  )

# ── Step 5: Extreme VPD days in summer — frequency trend ─────────────────────
vpd_summer %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(n_extreme = sum(extreme, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n_extreme)) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, colour = "#F28C28") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "#4682B4", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "No. extreme VPD days (summer)",
       title = "Are summer VPD extremes becoming more frequent?") +
  theme_classic()

# ── Step 6: Do summer extremes suppress GPP? ─────────────────────────────────
vpd_summer %>%
  filter(site %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  mutate(extreme_flag = ifelse(extreme, "Extreme VPD", "Normal")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = extreme_flag, y = GPP, fill = extreme_flag)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Extreme VPD" = "#F28C28", "Normal" = "#4682B4")) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GPP",
       title = "Do summer VPD extremes suppress GPP?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
```{r}
# ── Step 1: Seasonal GPP ~ VPD sensitivity across all sites ──────────────────
vpd_seasonal <- bind_rows(sites_daily) %>%
  drop_na(VPD, GPP, date) %>%
  mutate(
    season = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Summer",
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5)  ~ "Autumn",
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8)  ~ "Winter",
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Spring"
    ),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Summer", "Autumn", "Winter", "Spring"))
  )

# ── Step 2: GPP ~ VPD slope per site per season ───────────────────────────────
seasonal_sensitivity <- vpd_seasonal %>%
  group_by(site, season) %>%
  filter(n() >= 30) %>%
  summarise(
    vpd_slope = coef(lm(GPP ~ VPD))[2],
    R2        = summary(lm(GPP ~ VPD))$r.squared,
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

# ── Step 3: Plot seasonal sensitivity across sites ────────────────────────────
# Order sites by wet to dry or LAI
seasonal_sensitivity %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = vpd_slope, fill = season)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Summer" = "#F28C28",
    "Autumn" = "#c44e52",
    "Winter" = "#4682B4",
    "Spring" = "#2ca02c"
  )) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GPP ~ VPD slope", fill = NULL,
       title = "Seasonal GPP sensitivity to VPD across Australian sites") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")

# ── Step 4: R² per season — where does VPD explain most variance? ─────────────
seasonal_sensitivity %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, levels = wet_to_dry_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = R2, fill = season)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Summer" = "#F28C28",
    "Autumn" = "#c44e52",
    "Winter" = "#4682B4",
    "Spring" = "#2ca02c"
  )) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "R² (GPP ~ VPD)", fill = NULL,
       title = "How much variance does VPD explain per season?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top")

# ── Step 5: Extreme VPD events suppress GPP — summer vs other seasons ─────────
vpd_seasonal %>%
  group_by(site, season) %>%
  mutate(
    vpd_p95 = quantile(VPD, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    extreme = VPD > vpd_p95
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(extreme_flag = ifelse(extreme, "Extreme VPD", "Normal")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = season, y = GPP, fill = extreme_flag)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Extreme VPD" = "#F28C28", "Normal" = "#4682B4")) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GPP", fill = NULL,
       title = "Does extreme VPD suppress GPP, and is summer worst?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
# ── Rebuild vpd_extremes_summer_all with vpd_z included ──────────────────────
vpd_extremes_summer_all <- bind_rows(sites_daily) %>%
  drop_na(VPD, GPP, date) %>%
  mutate(
    year  = year(date),
    month = month(date)
  ) %>%
  filter(month %in% c(12, 1, 2)) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    vpd_mean    = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    vpd_sd      = sd(VPD,   na.rm = TRUE),       # ADD THIS
    vpd_anomaly = VPD - vpd_mean,
    vpd_z       = vpd_anomaly / vpd_sd,           # ADD THIS
    vpd_p95     = quantile(VPD, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
    extreme     = VPD > vpd_p95
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Then re-join PFT/koppen
vpd_extremes_summer_grouped <- vpd_extremes_summer_all %>%
  left_join(site_meta_2 %>% select(site, PFT, koppen_climate), by = "site")

vpd_mag_pft <- vpd_extremes_summer_grouped %>%
  filter(extreme) %>%
  group_by(PFT, year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_z       = mean(vpd_z,       na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_anomaly = mean(vpd_anomaly, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sites      = n_distinct(site),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_sites >= 2)

ggplot(vpd_mag_pft, aes(x = year, y = mean_z, colour = PFT)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ PFT, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean z-score VPD on extreme days",
       title = "Are summer VPD extremes intensifying by PFT?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# significance per PFT
vpd_mag_pft %>%
  group_by(PFT) %>%
  filter(n() >= 5) %>%
  summarise(
    slope   = coef(lm(mean_z ~ year))[2],
    p_value = summary(lm(mean_z ~ year))$coefficients[2, 4],
    n_years = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_value)

# ── Step 4: GPP suppression during extremes per PFT ──────────────────────────
vpd_extremes_summer_grouped %>%
  drop_na(GPP) %>%
  mutate(extreme_flag = ifelse(extreme, "Extreme VPD", "Normal")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = extreme_flag, y = GPP, fill = extreme_flag)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Extreme VPD" = "#F28C28", "Normal" = "#4682B4")) +
  facet_wrap(~ PFT, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "GPP (g C m⁻² day⁻¹)", fill = NULL,
       title = "Does extreme summer VPD suppress GPP by PFT?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Wilcoxon per PFT
vpd_extremes_summer_grouped %>%
  drop_na(GPP) %>%
  group_by(PFT) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value    = wilcox.test(GPP ~ extreme, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    normal_GPP = mean(GPP[!extreme], na.rm = TRUE),
    extreme_GPP = mean(GPP[extreme], na.rm = TRUE),
    suppression_pct = ((extreme_GPP - normal_GPP) / normal_GPP) * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(suppression_pct)

# ── Step 5: Repeat Steps 2-4 by Koppen zone ───────────────────────────────────
vpd_freq_koppen <- vpd_extremes_summer_grouped %>%
  group_by(koppen_climate, year) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_extreme = mean(extreme, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sites      = n_distinct(site),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_sites >= 2)

ggplot(vpd_freq_koppen, aes(x = year, y = prop_extreme, colour = koppen_climate)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~ koppen_climate, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of extreme VPD days",
       title = "Are summer VPD extremes becoming more frequent by climate zone?") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

vpd_extremes_summer_grouped %>%
  drop_na(GPP) %>%
  group_by(koppen_climate) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value         = wilcox.test(GPP ~ extreme, alternative = "greater")$p.value,
    normal_GPP      = mean(GPP[!extreme], na.rm = TRUE),
    extreme_GPP     = mean(GPP[extreme],  na.rm = TRUE),
    suppression_pct = ((extreme_GPP - normal_GPP) / normal_GPP) * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(suppression_pct)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- Step 0: Convert to data frame if sites_daily is a list ---

sites_all_data <- bind_rows(sites_daily, .id = "site")


# --- Step 1: Compute the 90th percentile VPD threshold per site ---
sites_all_data <- sites_all_data %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    vpd_90th  = quantile(VPD, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    vpd_group = if_else(VPD > vpd_90th, "Extreme VPD (>90th)", "Normal VPD (≤90th)")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Make vpd_group a factor with a clear order
sites_all_data$vpd_group <- factor(
  sites_all_data$vpd_group,
  levels = c("Normal VPD (≤90th)", "Extreme VPD (>90th)")
)

# --- Step 2: Set how many sites per page ---
sites_per_page <- 4
all_sites      <- unique(sites_all_data$site)
n_pages        <- ceiling(length(all_sites) / sites_per_page)

# --- Step 3: Build a base plot function ---
make_plot <- function(data) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = vpd_group, y = GPP, fill = vpd_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      outlier.shape = 21,
      outlier.size  = 1.5,
      outlier.alpha = 0.5,
      width         = 0.6
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Normal VPD (≤90th)"  = "#4CAF93",
        "Extreme VPD (>90th)" = "#E06C4B"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = "GPP under Normal vs. Extreme VPD conditions",
      subtitle = "Extreme VPD defined as > 90th percentile per site",
      x        = NULL,
      y        = expression("GPP (g C m"^{-2}~"day"^{-1}*")"),
      fill     = "VPD condition"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#2E3440", colour = NA),
      strip.text         = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold"),
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      axis.text.x        = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x       = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )
}

# --- Step 4: Print each page ---
for (i in seq_len(n_pages)) {
  site_subset <- all_sites[((i - 1) * sites_per_page + 1):min(i * sites_per_page, length(all_sites))]
  data_subset <- filter(sites_all_data, site %in% site_subset)
  print(make_plot(data_subset))
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

sites_extreme <- sites_all_data %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(vpd_90th = quantile(VPD, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(VPD > vpd_90th) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Step 2: Paginated plot function (4 sites per page, 2x2 grid) ---
sites_per_page <- 4
all_sites      <- unique(sites_extreme$site)
n_pages        <- ceiling(length(all_sites) / sites_per_page)

make_trend_plot <- function(data) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = date, y = VPD)) +
    geom_point(
      colour = "#E06C4B",
      alpha  = 0.35,
      size   = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method    = "lm",
      se        = TRUE,
      colour    = "#2E3440",
      fill      = "#aab0bd",
      linewidth = 0.9
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    labs(
      title    = "Trend in extreme VPD (>90th percentile) over time",
      subtitle = "Each point is a day exceeding the site-level 90th percentile VPD threshold",
      x        = NULL,
      y        = "VPD (kPa)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#2E3440", colour = NA),
      strip.text       = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# --- Step 3: Print each page ---
for (i in seq_len(n_pages)) {
  site_subset <- all_sites[((i - 1) * sites_per_page + 1):min(i * sites_per_page, length(all_sites))]
  data_subset <- filter(sites_extreme, site %in% site_subset)
  print(make_trend_plot(data_subset))
}
```
Millennium drought (2001-2009) and the 'black summer bush fires' (2019/2020)

Millennium drought - Tum, How

Black summer - [Cum], Asm, [Cpr], [Wom], Boy = [within area affected]

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)

# --- Step 1: Prepare data ---
black_summer_sites <- sites_all_data %>%
  mutate(
    date  = as.Date(date),
    year  = year(date),
    # Label years as Black Summer window or background
    period = case_when(
      year %in% c(2018, 2019) ~ "Black Summer (2018–2019)",
      TRUE                          ~ "Other years"
    ),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("Other years", "Black Summer (2018–2020)"))
  ) %>%
  filter(site %in% c("Cpr", "Cum", "Wom"))

# --- Step 2: Annual means per site for time series ---
annual_means <- black_summer_sites %>%
  group_by(site, year) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_VPD = mean(VPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_GPP = mean(GPP, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    period = if_else(year %in% c(2018, 2019),
                     "Black Summer (2018–2019)", "Other years"),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("Other years", "Black Summer (2018–2019)"))
  )

# --- Step 3: Colour palette ---
period_colours <- c(
  "Other years"              = "#4CAF93",
  "Black Summer (2018–2020)" = "#E06C4B"
)

# --- Step 4: Time series plots (VPD and GPP annual means) ---
p_vpd <- ggplot(annual_means, aes(x = year, y = mean_VPD, colour = period, group = site)) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = 2018, xmax = 2019, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    fill = "#fce8e2", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = period), size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = period_colours) +
  labs(
    title    = "Annual mean VPD",
    subtitle = "Shaded region = Black Summer window (2018–2019)",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = "Mean VPD (kPa)",
    colour   = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#2E3440", colour = NA),
    strip.text       = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold"),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_gpp <- ggplot(annual_means, aes(x = year, y = mean_GPP, colour = period, group = site)) +
  geom_rect(
    aes(xmin = 2018, xmax = 2019, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    fill = "#fce8e2", colour = NA, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = period), size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = period_colours) +
  labs(
    title    = "Annual mean GPP",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = expression("Mean GPP (g C m"^{-2}~"day"^{-1}*")"),
    colour   = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#2E3440", colour = NA),
    strip.text       = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold"),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# --- Step 5: Boxplots comparing Black Summer vs other years ---
p_vpd_box <- ggplot(black_summer_sites, aes(x = period, y = VPD, fill = period)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21, outlier.size = 1, outlier.alpha = 0.4, width = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = period_colours) +
  labs(
    title = "VPD distribution: Black Summer vs. other years",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "VPD (kPa)",
    fill  = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#2E3440", colour = NA),
    strip.text         = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold"),
    legend.position    = "none",
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

p_gpp_box <- ggplot(black_summer_sites, aes(x = period, y = GPP, fill = period)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 21, outlier.size = 1, outlier.alpha = 0.4, width = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = period_colours) +
  labs(
    title = "GPP distribution: Black Summer vs. other years",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = expression("GPP (g C m"^{-2}~"day"^{-1}*")"),
    fill  = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#2E3440", colour = NA),
    strip.text         = element_text(colour = "white", face = "bold"),
    legend.position    = "none",
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

# --- Step 6: Print all panels (stacked with patchwork) ---
print(p_vpd / p_gpp)
print(p_vpd_box / p_gpp_box)
```
